description: Runs from the cluster (kubernetes/prod/services/renovate/). Every update is a pull request for the owner to merge; nothing merges itself.

customManagers.description: CloudNativePG clusters name their image as imageName, which the kubernetes manager doesn't read.

packageRules.description: A captured release is updated through its generated files; regenerate so release.yaml, values.yaml and the generated files agree (scripts/renovate_post_upgrade.py).
A database's major version is a migration (QUEUE-updates.md), not a version bump: listed on the Dependency Dashboard, opened only when ticked there. Likewise Whisparr's v3, a different app.
vectorchord's tags are <PostgreSQL major>-<extension version>: only the extension moves.
One pull request for the app-template chart across every release that uses it.
OpenTofu, not Terraform: providers from OpenTofu's registry, and required_version (an exact OpenTofu version, matching Semaphore's) left to a hand update.
